description: Fetch pages or make scoped HTTP requests without a browser
author: Serg Parf

get.help: GET a public HTTP(S) URL; bare URLs work too. JSON accepts format text (default) or markdown. Every success starts with the external-content warning. No JavaScript or subresources; run only on nodes without DNS64

args.name: url
args.help: Public URL, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; ports 80, 443, 8080 or 8443 only

curl.help: Make one bounded HTTP request; text curl <VERB> <url> [body...] or full JSON. Return warning then status, duplicate headers and lossless raw body. No CONNECT, retries, insecure TLS or stored credentials. A sent request may have an unknown outcome

args.name: verb
args.help: Case-sensitive ASCII HTTP token, at most32 bytes; CONNECT refused; TRACE and bounded GET/HEAD bodies allowed

args.name: url
args.help: HTTP(S) URL, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; each hop must match this instance policy

args.name: headers
args.help: JSON only: at most64 headers/16384 bytes; no Host, hop/proxy/framing/Expect or Sec-WebSocket headers

args.name: body_base64
args.help: JSON only: strict base64 for at most262144 raw bytes, mutually exclusive with body

args.name: body
args.help: UTF-8 request text, sent unchanged; at most262144 bytes. Omit for empty body

allow.help: Optional list of at most64 bare hosts or HTTP(S) URL patterns; only * is wildcard. Omitted: public-only; []: deny all. Every request/hop must match. Matching entries without * grant private unicast and all ports in their scope: a bare exact host exposes ALL ports/paths to every ACL grantee; prefer an exact full URL for a narrow grant. Wildcards remain public-only on ports80/443/8080/8443
